title: Towards Adaptive and Real-Survey-Aligned Simulated Urban Mobility Behaviour of Generative Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22407v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In existing agent-based simulations of multimodal urban mobility, agents, representing humans, choose their travel modes either using discrete choice or machine learning models fitted on structured travel survey data, or with rules explicitly written by the domain experts. Such approaches fix a priori the agents' possible behaviour space. Hence, a factor absent from variables or rules cannot affect agents' decisions. In reality, choosing a transport mode is a multidimensional decision in which objective and subjective factors intertwine and change over time. Integrating such complexity into a city-scale multimodal mobility simulation remains a challenge. Generative agents (GAs) built on large language models promise to respond to this challenge because they carry decision heuristics that travel surveys do not record. However, to the best of our knowledge, aligning their decisions with real household travel surveys remains an open quest

translated_title: 迈向自适应且与真实调查对齐的生成式智能体城市出行行为模拟
translated_abstract: 在现有的基于智能体的多模式城市出行模拟中，代表人类的智能体要么使用基于结构化出行调查数据拟合的离散选择模型或机器学习模型来选择出行方式，要么遵循由领域专家明确编写的规则。这些方法先验地固定了智能体可能的行为空间，因此，变量或规则中未涵盖的因素无法影响智能体的决策。在现实中，选择交通方式是一个多维度的决策过程，其中客观与主观因素相互交织并随时间变化。将这种复杂性融入城市尺度的多模式出行模拟中仍然是一项挑战。基于大语言模型构建的生成式智能体有望应对这一挑战，因为它们具备出行调查中未记录的决策启发式经验。然而，据我们所知，将其决策与真实的家庭出行调查对齐仍是一个尚未解决的难题。
tldr: 本文提出利用基于大语言模型的生成式智能体来模拟城市多模式出行决策，突破传统离散选择模型和专家规则预先限定行为空间的局限，并指出将其决策与真实家庭出行调查对齐仍是待解决的关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using large language model-based generative agents to simulate multimodal urban mobility decisions, overcoming the predefined behavior space of traditional discrete choice models and expert rules, while highlighting that aligning their decisions with real household travel surveys remains an open challenge.
